login.title: Made2Found
login.subtitle: Sign in with a magic link if you already have access.
login.invitationSignupHint: This invitation can create a new profile via magic link.
login.orgInviteHint: You were invited to join an organization. Enter the email address the invitation was sent to. You will get a sign-in link, and a new account is created if you do not have one. After that you see the invitation and confirm with one click.
login.newUserHint: New here? Start with your access code.

errors.magicLinkFailed: The magic link could not be confirmed. Please request a new link.
errors.authCallbackFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.generic: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
errors.linkExpired: This link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one below.
errors.linkIncomplete: This link arrived incomplete. Requesting a new one won't help – this is a setting on our side, so please contact the team.

status.signedOutEverywhere: You're now signed out on all devices. Sign in again with a new link.

start.title: Welcome to Made2Found
start.subtitle: Enter your email and access code – we'll sort out the rest with you once you're in.
start.existingAccess: If you already have access, you can sign in directly.

status.sent: If the details match, we will send you a magic link. Please also check your spam folder.
status.invalid: We couldn't open access with these details. Please check them or request access.
status.sendFailed: The magic link could not be sent right now. Please try again.
status.notConfigured: No access codes are set up on this server yet. This isn't caused by anything you entered – please contact the team.
status.connectFailed: Your Connect access could not be set up securely. Please start again with your access code.
status.rateLimited: Too many sign-in emails are going out right now – this isn't about you. Please try again in a few minutes.
status.cooldown: An email was only just sent to this address. Wait about a minute and try again – or use the email that is already on its way.

signedIn.title: You are signed in
signedIn.text: Your account is not assigned to an area yet (founding, advising or Connect). Write to us briefly and we will set it up. Until then you can look at your account.

magicLinkForm.hint: The sign-in link is valid for 60 minutes.
magicLinkForm.sentExisting: If an account exists, we will send you a link. If you are new, please use "Get started".
magicLinkForm.sentInvitation: If the email matches the invitation, we will send you a link.
magicLinkForm.configurationError: Login configuration is incomplete. Please check the public app URL.
magicLinkForm.rateLimited: Too many sign-in emails are going out right now – this isn't about you. Please try again in a few minutes. If you already received an email, the link in it still works.
magicLinkForm.noMailHint: Nothing arriving? Check your spam folder. If you do not have an account yet, you need an access code first.
magicLinkForm.originMismatch: We sent the link, but it points to {origin}. You're currently on a different address – sign in there or let the team know.
magicLinkForm.rateLimitedCooldown: An email was only just sent to this address. Wait {seconds} seconds and try again – or use the email that is already on its way.

emailCode.title: Or use the code from the email
emailCode.hint: The same email contains a six-digit code. It is valid for one hour.
emailCode.hintInApp: The same email contains a six-digit code. Use the code here, not the link: the link opens your browser, and you would be signed in there – not here.

errors.invalid: That code isn't correct. Check the latest email – older codes no longer work.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Request a new one above.
errors.failed: That didn't work just now. Try again in a moment.
